entry.title: Xiaoyu Xie
entry.content:
Xiaoyu Xie

Research Scientist at Meta · Ph.D. at Northwestern University

My research integrates physics and prior knowledge into machine learning to build interpretable, scalable AI, with applications in scientific discovery, additive manufacturing, fluid mechanics, and ads bidding. My Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering was advised by Prof. Wing Kam Liu.

EmailGoogle ScholarGitHubLinkedIn

Research

01

Discovery of Governing Laws

Dimensionless numbers, scaling laws, and PDEs from scarce, noisy data.

02

Reduced-Order Modeling

Compact latent dynamics for fast, accurate spatiotemporal surrogates.

03

ML-Based Digital Twins

Process–structure–property prediction in metal additive manufacturing.

Also interested in computer vision and multimodal learning.

News

  • Sep 2024I joined Meta as a Research Scientist.

  • Feb 2024Published internship paper on operator learning: "Smooth and Sparse Latent Dynamics in Operator Learning with Jerk Regularization" on arXiv.
